Notes WHERE IsDeleted=0 AND IsLatest=1, joined to Charts on KeyNumber=ChartNum. IsSignedOff is NULL throughout Fictional Data.

Imaging tables are readable but hold zero rows database-wide (AImage=0, AImageVersion=0, TDIImageLink=0, Imaging=0, Document=0). 9 AImageToothNumber rows reference images that no longer exist, so Fictional Data once had images and ships without them. Cannot distinguish 'none recorded' from 'not visible to this driver'; treat as indeterminate until the imaging spike resolves it. Manual upload is the only radiograph source for now.
